beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the arguments alongside the ordinary people who keep demanding practical consequences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full book tests purpose against suffering, counterfeit certainty, plural traditions, and responsibility toward others.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its invitation is to examine how care becomes action without demanding a final cosmic guarantee.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it for a conversation where seriousness, uncertainty, and laughter can share the same room.
